DERIVATION: seeds are drawn deterministically from SHA-256 of f'TBRT01|{parent_tip}|{counter}', taking the low 32 bits of each digest, skipping any value in the frozen forbidden set or already drawn. No randomness, no choice.
RESERVES_ARE_TECHNICAL_ONLY: a technical retry reuses the identical seed and arm. A scientific non-trigger consumes its seed and is NEVER replaced.
